Released 2026-10-01 · [downloads and checksums on GitHub](https://github.com/BuenGenio/backdown-releases/releases/tag/v1.0.0-beta.2) · [Download page](/download/)
The second beta of BackDown 1.0: faster on very large indexes, easier to reach from your other devices, and Tab completion in the terminal.

## Install

| Platform | Installer | Command line |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | `backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.2_amd64.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu) or `.AppImage` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (static) |
| Linux ARM64 | `backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.2_arm64.deb` or `.AppImage` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.2-linux-arm64.tar.gz` (static) |
| macOS (Apple silicon + Intel) | `BackDown-1.0.0-beta.2.dmg` | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.2-macos-universal.tar.gz` |
| Windows x86-64 | `BackDown-1.0.0-beta.2-x64.msi` (no administrator rights needed) | `backdown-v1.0.0-beta.2-windows-x86_64.zip` |

**The Linux package is now called `backdown-io`.** Debian and Ubuntu have an unrelated duplicate remover called `backdown`, and apt could have offered it as an "upgrade" of ours. `sudo apt install ./backdown-io_*.deb` replaces the `backdown` package of beta.1 (and that other program, since both install `/usr/bin/backdown`). If a terminal ever suggests `sudo apt install backdown`, that's the other one.

**These builds aren't signed yet.** On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open the first time (for the command-line binary: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine backdown`). On Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm once. Verify any download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's new since beta.1

- **Large indexes**: the duplicates report answers in seconds rather than minutes on an index of 17 million files, from a covering index the background service builds once after the upgrade ("Prepare the duplicates index" in Activity). The app's first screen no longer waits for the index's totals, which are now counted in one pass and kept, and `backdown service status` answers at once.
- **Look from your other devices**: `--host` now answers to the computer's full Tailscale name (`name.tailnet-….ts.net`) as well as its address and short name; `BACKDOWN_HOST_NAMES` allows others. From other devices BackDown still only shows what's there.
- **`backdown token`**: the background service's browser token, and with `--links` the links with it in, for this computer and for your other devices.
- **Tab completion**: `backdown completions --install` for bash, zsh or fish; the `.deb` sets it up for everyone.
- **Servers**: `backdown service install` explains what to do instead of half-installing when it's run with `sudo` or without a login session.

## Known limitations

- Built locally, not by CI. Every test passed on Linux; the macOS and Windows builds are checked but haven't yet run on those systems. Please report anything that doesn't work: https://github.com/BuenGenio/backdown-releases/issues
- The builds aren't signed or notarised.
- Pro features are free during the beta; pricing may change before 1.0.

Documentation: https://backdown.io/docs/. Provided as-is, without warranty, for evaluation.
